method: Actual0..20s world-bone matrices; same fixed material sole vertices throughout, central finite differences on the interior0.0167..19.9833s; primary summaries exclude stationary observations and classify moving Walk, start/stop, authored turns and heading turns. Contact persistence is computed before these classification masks. Fixed heel/toe vertices are selected once from bind-pose sole geometry. Separately, the lowest sole material point uses the derivative of that SAME vertex, not the derivative of a changing minimum selector. Contact inference uses height<=20mm and abs(vertical speed)<=0.10m/s for contiguous>=80ms, NEVER horizontal speed. The same-current-rig reference uses unchanged authored Walk including native Hips translation at120Hz; no Idle blend or world-path follower. Raw source vertical placement is retained. No motion is modified.
limitations: Contacts are inferred rather than authored annotations. Foot rocking, yaw, shoe shape and vertical grounding affect the result; source and actual clock/trajectory differ. A numerical increase is evidence of actual support motion, not an isolated causal experiment proving that blend weight alone caused it.
Current-rig reference controls geometry. The older native-source baseline below uses different original clothing/geometry and is supplementary.
This is only the first20s of a changed route. It is NOT an isolated weight A/B against the previous trajectory and does not establish perpetual liveness.
scopeNote: The artificial exit waypoint is removed, so this is a changed-route observation, not the isolated temporal-weight A/B.
